newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish consumer confidence indicator slips in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Danish consumer confidence indicator slips in Sept.

text.p: Denmark's consumer confidence indicator was +4 in September, down from +6 in August 1996, the National Statistics Office said on Thursday.

NOTE: The survey asks a cross section of Denmark's population its views on current personal and national economic trends, along with consumer intentions for coming months. Changes in consumer confidence are indicated by a higher or lower weighted rating, rather than by index. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969650
